'''Togo Shrine''' is a shrine dedicated to {{ill|Tōgō Heihachirō|en|Tōgō_Heihachirō|qid=Q296785|lt=Heihachiro Togo}}.

Other known shrines include the Nogi Shrine, which enshrines {{ill|Nogi Maresuke|en|Nogi_Maresuke|qid=Q468122|lt=Nogi Maresuke}}, and the [[Kodama Shrines]], which enshrines {{ill|Kodama Gentarō|en|Kodama_Gentarō|qid=Q72515|lt=Gentaro Kodama}}.
